unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?

sections.title: Present Simple in a text — Jack Warren

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the verbs in the list in the correct form.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan to'g'ri shaklda to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
FE'LLAR RO'YXATI VA SONI:
  finish (x2), enjoy, go (x3), watch, get up,
  have (x3), be (x2), start, read

JAMI 15 ta — bo'shliqlar soni bilan bir xil.
Qavsdagi son o'sha fe'l NECHA MARTA ishlatilishini aytadi.
Bu — o'zingizni tekshirish uchun yaxshi usul.

BARCHA FE'LLAR 3-SHAXS BIRLIKDA (Jack / He / The show):
  be     → is
  get up → gets up
  have   → has
  go     → goes
  finish → finishes
  start  → starts
  read   → reads
  watch  → watches
  enjoy  → enjoys

ISTISNO — 15-bo'shliq: Jek O'ZI gapiryapti ('I ...'),
shuning uchun 'am' bo'ladi.

JEK — 'NIGHT OWL':
U tush paytida turadi va soat 1 da yotadi — chunki aktyor.

lines.textEn: Jack Warren 1) ____ (be) an actor at the local theatre.
He 2) ____ (get up) late, at about midday, ...
lines.whyUz: Oddiy -s. 'midday' = tush payti (noon bilan bir xil).
ISTISNO: have → has. 'have a shower' = dush qabul qilmoq.

lines.textEn: ... and then he 5) ____ (go) to the theatre for rehearsal.
... and Jack usually 7) ____ (go) home to rest before the show.
Afterwards, he 10) ____ (have) dinner with some of the other actors from the show.
He 11) ____ (go) to bed at about 1 am.
In his free time, Jack 12) ____ (read) books ...
"I 15) ____ (be) very satisfied with my career, and I love the people I work with."
lines.hintUz: Bu safar EGA 'I' — Jek o'zi gapiryapti
lines.whyUz: 'I' bilan AM. 'satisfied WITH' — predlog shart. 'a career' = kasbiy faoliyat.

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapda matnga ZID ma'lumot bor.
Matnga qaytib, to'g'ri ma'lumotni toping.

Bu mashq matnni DIQQAT bilan o'qishga o'rgatadi —
xato ko'pincha bitta raqam yoki so'zda bo'ladi.

items.textEn: 1  Jack Warren gets up early in the morning.
items.answer: Jack Warren gets up late, at about midday.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'He gets up LATE, at about MIDDAY'. U aktyor — kechasi ishlaydi.

items.textEn: 2  Jack has lunch at about 10 am.
items.answer: Jack has lunch at about 1 pm.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'lunch at about 1 pm'. 10 am — u hali uxlayapti.
Matnda: 'Rehearsal finishes at about 4 pm'.

items.textEn: 4  The show starts at 9 pm and finishes at about 11 pm.
items.answer: The show starts at 8 pm and finishes at about 10 pm.
items.whyUz: IKKI xato: 9 emas 8, 11 emas 10.

items.textEn: 5  Jack goes to bed at about 3 am.
items.answer: Jack goes to bed at about 1 am.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'He goes to bed at about 1 am'.

items.textEn: 6  Jack goes fishing and plays computer games in his free time.
items.answer: Jack reads books and watches TV in his free time.
items.whyUz: IKKI xato: matnda 'reads books and watches TV'.

items.textEn: 7  Jack isn't very satisfied with his career.
items.answer: Jack is very satisfied with his career.
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'I am very satisfied with my career'. Inkor emas, TASDIQ.

exercises.explanationUz:
1–5-unitlarning grammatikasi aralash:
  this/these/that/those (Unit 3)
  egalik sifati va olmoshi (Unit 4)
  qaratqich 's / s' (Unit 4)
  to be (Unit 1)
  its / it's (Unit 4)
  there is/are (Unit 3)

Har bir bandda EGA yoki FE'L ko'plikmi-birlikmi ekaniga qarang —
bu ko'pincha javobni beradi.

items.whyUz: 'Are' va 'shoes' KO'PLIK → 'these' yoki 'those'. Variantlar ichida faqat 'these' ko'plik.
'cousin' oti bor → egalik SIFATI 'my'. 'mine cousin' XATO.
Egalik kerak → ism + 's. 'Jerry bicycle' ma'nosiz.
'they' → are → inkor 'aren't'. 'No' bilan boshlangani uchun inkor.

items.textEn: 5  I have got a dog. ____ name is Spot.
items.whyUz: It (hayvon) uchun egalik sifati → ITS (apostrofsiz!). 'It's' = it is — ma'nosiz bo'lardi.
Ko'plik → 'These' yoki 'Those'. Variantlar ichida faqat 'Those'.
Egalik kerak: 'my son's pencil' = o'g'limning qalami. 'my son pencil' ma'nosiz.
'I' bilan AM. Yosh 'to be' bilan aytiladi.

items.textEn: 9  ____ is an armchair in the living-room.
items.whyUz: 'There is' = bor (Unit 3). 'Those/These is' grammatik xato — ular ko'plik.
'that girl' — BITTA qiz ('that' birlik) → 's. Ko'plik bo'lsa 'those girls'' bo'lardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the present simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni Present Simple ning to'g'ri shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAVSDAGI BELGILAR:
  (Peter/work)  → savol tuzing: Does Peter work?
  (get up)      → tasdiq: gets up
  (not/be)      → inkor: isn't
  (you/like)    → savol: Do you like?

UCH TURDAGI FE'L:
  'to be'    → am / is / are, inkor: isn't / aren't
  'have'     → has, inkor: doesn't have
  oddiy fe'l → -s, savol: does + asos, inkor: doesn't + asos

DIQQAT — 'to be' bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI:
  ✅ Where ARE they from?
  ❌ Where do they be from?

items.whyUz: 'work' oddiy fe'l, 'Peter' 3-shaxs birlik → DOES + asos shakl.

items.textEn: 2  My father ____ (get up) early on Sundays, but my mother doesn't.
items.whyUz: 'My father' 3-shaxs birlik, tasdiq → gets up. 'but my mother doesn't' — inkor takrorlanmaydi.
'you' bilan DO. 'like' dan keyin -ING (fishing).
'to be' fe'li — do/does KERAK EMAS. Savolda 'are' oldinga chiqadi: Where ARE THEY from?
'Mark' 3-shaxs birlik. UNLI + y → oddiy -s: plays.
'Ben' 3-shaxs birlik → listens. 'listen TO' — predlog shart.
'to be' + sifat. 3-shaxs birlik → is.
'to be' inkori → isn't. 'doesn't' KERAK EMAS. Sifat takrorlanmaydi.
'live' oddiy fe'l, 'Kirk' 3-shaxs birlik → DOES + asos shakl.
'have' — oddiy fe'l → doesn't have. 'hasn't got' ham to'g'ri.
3-shaxs birlik tasdiq → has. 'has got' ham to'g'ri.

items.textEn: 9  How many rooms ____ (be) there in your house?
items.whyUz: 'rooms' KO'PLIK → are. 'How many rooms ARE THERE ...?' — Unit 3 tuzilmasi.

items.textEn: 10  What ____ (Tony/like) doing in his free time?
items.whyUz: 'like' oddiy fe'l, 'Tony' 3-shaxs birlik → DOES. So'roq so'zi ('What') eng oldinda.

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 24-bet — teatr so'zlari va 3-shaxs shakllari.

groups.explanationUz: Bir matnda to'rt xil imlo qoidasi ishlatilgan.

patterns.formula: EGA + is + A/AN + kasb + AT + ish joyi.
patterns.exampleEn: Jack Warren is an actor at the local theatre.
patterns.explanationUz: Kasb oldida artikl SHART. Ish joyi bilan AT.

patterns.formula: The show starts AT + vaqt and finishes AT + vaqt.
patterns.exampleEn: The show starts at 8 pm and finishes at about 10 pm.
patterns.exampleUz: Tomosha kechqurun soat 8 da boshlanadi va taxminan 10 da tugaydi.
patterns.explanationUz: Ikki fe'l bir egaga tegishli — ikkalasi ham -s oladi.

patterns.exampleEn: Does Peter work in the city centre? Does Kirk live in Paris?
patterns.exampleUz: Piter shahar markazida ishlaydimi? Kirk Parijda yashaydimi?

patterns.formula: Where are + EGA + from? ('to be' bilan)
patterns.explanationUz: 'to be' bilan do/does ISHLATILMAYDI — fe'lning o'zi oldinga chiqadi.

patterns.formula: EGA + is + sifat BUT EGA + isn't.
patterns.exampleEn: My sister is very polite but my brother isn't.
patterns.exampleUz: Singlim juda muloyim, lekin akam emas.
patterns.explanationUz: Ikkinchi qismda sifat TAKRORLANMAYDI — faqat 'isn't' qoladi.

patterns.formula: How many + ko'plik ot + are there + IN + joy?
patterns.exampleEn: How many rooms are there in your house?
patterns.explanationUz: 'How many' + ko'plik ot + ARE THERE. Unit 3 tuzilmasi.

patterns.formula: What does + EGA + like doing + IN + vaqt?
patterns.exampleEn: What does Tony like doing in his free time?
patterns.exampleUz: Toni bo'sh vaqtida nima qilishni yoqtiradi?
patterns.explanationUz: 'like' dan keyin -ING. So'roq so'zi eng oldinda, keyin 'does'.
